module purpose: Implements an XTEA co-processor: a 4-word key is written via CSR, the block accepts start/type/function selectors and operands (rs1_i, rs2_i), performs XTEA round computations updating internal registers (xtea.sum, xtea.res, xtea.done) and exports the computed result and validity (result_o, valid_o); CSR readback of key_mem is provided.

use-case flows.value: write a 32-bit word into the key memory (key_mem) via CSR write
start request that captures operands and arms the XTEA core when rtype indicates the co-processor operation
XTEA internal step: update sum and compute res from operands, tmp values and key_mem
select and drive result_o and valid_o from internal XTEA state (res / done) or produce init/zero responses
read back a key_mem word onto csr_rdata_o
reset clears key_mem and the XTEA registers (done, opa, opb, sum, res)

conceptual assets.concept: Key material stored in key_mem (4-word key)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The RTL shows a dedicated key_mem register array that is cleared on reset and written by CSR writes (process csr_write_access: reset at line 176, write when csr_we_i='1' at line 178 and assignment at line 179). The key_mem word is read back at line 185 into csr_rdata_o. The relationship map records key_mem CLOCKED_BY at its occurrence 3 (line 179) and shows csr_wdata_i CARRIES to key_mem at csr_wdata_i occurrence 2 (line 179) and csr_we_i GATES the write at csr_we_i occurrence 2 (line 178); csr_rdata_o DERIVES_FROM key_mem at csr_rdata_o occurrence 2 (line 185). These RTL statements and map records establish that the integrity of key_mem matters to configured-key usage and to readback.

conceptual assets.concept: XTEA operands (operand A and operand B) captured for a started operation
conceptual assets.reasoning: Operands are captured when a start is issued: RTL assigns xtea.opa <= rs1_i and xtea.opb <= rs2_i under the start condition (lines 204-207). The map shows rs1_i CARRIES to xtea.opa at rs1_i occurrence 2 (line 205) and rs2_i CARRIES to xtea.opb at rs2_i occurrence 2 (line 206). The captured registers are clocked (xtea.opa CLOCKED_BY at xtea.opa occurrence 3, line 205; xtea.opb CLOCKED_BY at xtea.opb occurrence 3, line 206). The integrity of these operand values is established because the XTEA computation (xtea.res) and reported result depend on them (see operate and report flows).

conceptual assets.concept: XTEA internal round state (sum) used to index key_mem and steer the algorithm
conceptual assets.reasoning: xtea.sum is initialized on reset (line 196) and updated by the core when xtea.done(0) = '1' according to funct3 (lines 211-218). The sum is used to select key_mem entries (tmp_z uses xtea.sum bits at lines 236-237). The map shows xtea.sum is a register CLOCKED_BY clk_i at xtea.sum occurrence 3 (line 214) and that funct3_i gates/controls its update (funct3_i GATES record at funct3_i occurrence 2, line 213, targeting xtea.sum). These RTL statements and map records establish that the integrity of xtea.sum matters to the algorithm's control and to key indexing.

conceptual assets.concept: XTEA computed result (res) that the module exports as the operation result
conceptual assets.reasoning: xtea.res is computed from operands, tmp_r and sum (lines 221-225, 232-238) and is clocked into its register (reset at line 197, assigned under xtea.done gating lines 222,224). The result_select process drives result_o <= xtea.res for the XTEA enc/dec funct3 cases (line 249). The map shows xtea.res is CLOCKED_BY clk_i at xtea.res occurrence 3 (line 222) and that result_o COPIES xtea.res at result_o occurrence 2 (line 249). The RTL and map records establish the integrity of xtea.res as required for correct reported results.

conceptual assets.concept: XTEA completion event (done) that produces valid_o
conceptual assets.reasoning: xtea.done bits are driven and shifted in the XTEA core (lines 200-207) to indicate operation progress; result_select reports valid_o from xtea.done(1) for enc/dec cases (line 250). The map records xtea.done as a register CLOCKED_BY clk_i (xtea.done occurrence 4, line 201) and valid_o DERIVES_FROM xtea.done at valid_o occurrence 2 (line 250). These RTL lines and map records establish that the done flag's correctness is required for valid reporting of results.

conceptual assets.concept: Start request that arms operand capture and begins an XTEA operation
conceptual assets.reasoning: The RTL makes the start input the trigger for operand capture and for setting xtea.done(0) when rtype indicates the co-processor (if (start_i='1') and (rtype_i = r3type_c) then lines 204-207). The map records start_i GATES those assignments at start_i occurrence 2 (line 204) targeting xtea.done/xtea.opa/xtea.opb. This establishes the start input as the setting point whose integrity controls whether an operation begins.

conceptual assets.concept: Operation-type selector (rtype_i) that chooses whether the co-processor path is taken and which outputs are driven
conceptual assets.reasoning: rtype_i gates both the start capture (line 204) and the result_select process (lines 243-245) that chooses whether result_o/valid_o reflect XTEA outputs. The map shows rtype_i GATES the start assignment at rtype_i occurrence 2 (line 204) and GATES result outputs at rtype_i occurrence 4 (line 245). The RTL and map records establish that correctness of rtype_i determines which operation and outputs are produced.

conceptual assets.concept: Function selector (funct3_i) that selects XTEA enc/dec variants and local arithmetic behaviors
conceptual assets.reasoning: funct3_i is used inside the core to choose sum updates and arithmetic directions (lines 213-221) and in result selection (lines 247-249). The map records funct3_i SELECTS the result/valid branch at funct3_i occurrence 12 (line 247) targeting result_o/valid_o and shows several GATES records (e.g. at occurrence 2 line 213) that control xtea.sum and xtea.res updates. The RTL and map records therefore establish funct3_i as the control that must be correct for the chosen operation variant and computed results to be correct.
